text:
Nora Patel: Quick question from oncall: when you open a trace in the error drilldown, it's hard to find the correlation ID and export action. Current header hides corr id in a small badge and export is in the kebab. Can we surface both?

Diego Rivera: +1. Corr id should be copyable easily for Slack/chat ops. Suggest a small copy icon next to the ID and a visible 'Export' CTA in the header.

Keiko Sato: Design: I mocked a compact header that stacks on mobile. Desktop shows corr id left, title center, actions right. Export is a secondary button with label 'Export'. On narrow widths it's icon-only with a tooltip. https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/trace-tools

Owen Brooks: Implementation note: export currently packages trace + logs + spans. We could add a checkbox in a tiny flyout to include 'full stack traces' (on by default) and 'related requests' (off by default). Flyout avoids heavy modal.

Nora Patel: Flyout feels faster than modal. But for long-running exports we need a progress state. Show a modal if export takes >3s? Or just toast with spinner and aria-live updates?

accessibility-bot: Accessibility reminder: ensure the copy ID button has aria-label="Copy correlation ID" and the export action has aria-haspopup="menu" if it opens a flyout. Also ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5 for small text.

Keiko Sato: Good catch. I'll update colors. Also change copy tooltip to 'Copied!' persistent for 1.5s. Add keyboard shortcut suggestion: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E when trace panel focused to open export flyout.

Diego Rivera: For filenames, include trace id and corr id. Pattern: <traceid>_<corrid>_<ts>.zip. Backend can emit signed url. I'll add job API: POST /api/v1/traces/{id}/export -> 202 w/ job id. Poll GET /api/v1/exports/{job_id}. Response includes download_url when ready.

Nora Patel: Microcopy: under export flyout header write: 'Download a bundle of the trace, logs, and related metadata.' Buttons: primary 'Download' and secondary 'Cancel'. Also include a tiny note: 'Files may include PII — check privacy settings.'

Owen Brooks: On the server side we can redact PII if tenant config requires. We'll add an option in flyout: 'Redact sensitive fields' (off by default). That adds ~100ms to generation.

Keiko Sato: UX decision summary in figma: visible corr id with copy button, export CTA in header (labelled on desktop, icon-only on mobile), compact flyout for options (including redact toggle), toast + aria-live updates for progress, filename format includes ids. I'll push updated frames.

Nora Patel: Thanks! Can someone add acceptance criteria to the ticket: 1) copy button copies corr id to clipboard and shows "Copied!" tooltip; 2) export flyout reachable by keyboard and shortcut; 3) download filename uses agreed pattern; 4) aria-live announces progress and final success/failure. I'll own the follow-up.

Diego Rivera: Added backend notes to ticket and sample curl in comments.

accessibility-bot: Design review reminder: accessibility signoff required for any changes to header controls.
notes: Outcomes: surface corr id with copy, prominent Export CTA, compact flyout for options, keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E), aria-live progress, filename pattern <traceid>_<corrid>_<ts>.zip. Owners: Nora (follow-up), Keiko (design), Diego (backend), Owen (server/redact).
